Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog
public class ControlIQAutomatedInsulinHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
Control-IQ's rolling two-hour total of the insulin it commanded itself, written every 15 minutes (a 900-second timer from pump start-up, in the same second of the minute as DailyBasalHistoryLog). The three floats are sums in units over the last 24 five-minute Control-IQ cycles: for every cycle in which the algorithm was in control (BasalDeliveryHistoryLog source ALGORITHM or TEMP_RATE_AND_ALGORITHM), the commanded basal rate times 5 minutes, plus each automatic correction bolus. User-initiated boluses are not counted. Rebuilt from the 227 cycle times, BasalDelivery (279) rates and automatic BolusDelivery (280) records, all three fields matched within 0.005 U in 84-100% of 1,241 records from four pumps (t:slim X2 and Mobi); the misses are one five-minute slot off, for exactly two hours.

All three are exactly 0 until Control-IQ has run in closed loop since the pump last started (ArmInitHistoryLog). When closed loop stops, old cycles still expire, so the sums fall to float rounding residue (magnitude below 2e-5 U), not to exactly 0.

These are pump-internal Control-IQ values: do not use them for dosing or IOB.

The class name is provisional: opcode 237 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi app's history log list. getUnknown22() is exposed raw. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpX2/issues/146.

    • getAutoBolusInsulin

      public float getAutoBolusInsulin()
      Automatic correction boluses in the window, counted at the Control-IQ cycle that decided them (47-141 s before the BolusDelivery STARTED record) and dropped two hours later. Matched the requested amount of all 20 automatic boluses seen, to 0.001 U. Three times it also held an amount with no automatic bolus record; each time the Control-IQ cycle fell during a user bolus.
      Returns:
      insulin in units (float32 at offset 18)
